account_access.description:
Result of `--check-access` (`not_checked` without it): `available` means the
provider's model metadata is visible to this key. Billing tier, prepaid credit,
and organization verification are not checked.

AccountAccess.description:
Whether a model is visible to the API key, from one free metadata call
(`--check-access`). `available` means only that the provider's model metadata
read succeeded; it does not show that the account can use the model: billing
tier, prepaid credit, and organization verification are not checked, so a paid
request can still be refused.

Artifact.description: A media file saved locally by Iris.

index.description: 0-based position among the outputs of one request/job.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file contents.

Billing.description: Whether a model's requests cost money: one of the listed values (paid: requests are billed to the provider account at its published prices; no free tier), or a value a later version of this schema_version adds. Read a value you do not know as: requests may cost money.

CommandName.description: Command identifier: one of the listed commands, or a command a later version of this schema_version adds.

ConstraintView.description:
A rule relating several options or inputs of one request. A request that breaks
it fails with `invalid_argument` and this `id` in `details.constraint`.

CostEstimate.description: A cost estimate. Always an estimate computed from Iris's published price table.

as_of.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the price table was checked.

basis.description:
Human-readable basis, e.g. "1 image × $0.067 (gemini-3.1-flash-image, 1K); input
and thinking tokens not included".

estimated.description: Always `true`: this is an estimate, not a bill.

id.description: Unique within one result, e.g. `credentials.openai` or `access.gemini.<model>`.

DoctorResult.description: `doctor`. The command exits 0 whenever the checks ran; read `healthy`.

healthy.description: False if any check has status `error`.

DownloadState.description: Download state of one output of a succeeded job.

ErrorBody.description: The error object of a failed command.

retryable.description: Whether running the same command again may succeed; null if unknown.

ErrorCategory.description: Coarse, stable grouping of error codes. Deserialization is tolerant like [`ErrorCode`].

ErrorCode.description: Stable, public error code (docs/json-contract.md): one of the listed codes, or a code a later version of this schema_version adds.

text.description: Text returned by the model alongside images, if any.

mask.description: Whether `--mask` is accepted (its rules are in `mask_requirements`).

mask_requirements.description: Rules a `--mask` must meet; null when masks are not accepted.

max_request_bytes.description:
Largest encoded request (prompt, options, and base64 inputs sent inline) the
provider accepts, if it documents one; Iris checks an upper bound of the size
locally.

JobStatus.description: Normalized status of a persisted provider-native job.

oneOf.description: Record written; submission request in flight (or the process died during it).
The provider may or may not have accepted the paid request. Never auto-resubmitted.
Accepted by the provider and not finished.
Finished successfully; outputs may or may not be downloaded yet.
The provider rejected the submission or reported the job failed.
The remote operation or its outputs are no longer available.

JobView.description: A persisted provider-native job, as shown to users and agents.

label.description:
The label the job was submitted with (`video generate --label`), unique among
the local job records; null without one.

model_source.description:
Where `model` came from: `flag` (`-m/--model`) or `config` (`video.model`);
`null` when the job record does not say.

output_plan.description:
Where `jobs wait` and `jobs download` save the outputs when given neither
`-o` nor `-d`: the target `video generate` recorded when it submitted the job.

prompt_fingerprint.description:
The fingerprint of the prompt the job was submitted with, never its text (not
even when `jobs.store_prompts` keeps the text in the record): enough to tell
which request created a job, such as one left `submitting` by a process that
was killed.

remote_expires_at.description:
Earliest time the provider may stop serving the outputs: submission time plus
the provider's documented retention (it may keep them longer). `null` until
the job has succeeded, and when the provider documents no retention.

request.description: Non-secret resolved request options (never the prompt text or input contents).

Lifecycle.description: Lifecycle stage as documented by the provider.

alpha_channel_required.description: The mask needs an alpha channel: its fully transparent areas are edited.

media_types.description: Accepted media types (sniffed from the content).

same_size_as_first_image.description: The mask must have the pixel dimensions of the first `--image`.

billing.description: Whether the model's requests cost money.

constraints.description: Rules relating several options or inputs (empty when there are none).

standard_cost.description:
What the standard output of the model's operations costs (as in
`models.list`); null when Iris cannot estimate the model's cost before a call.

summary.description:
What the model is for and its trade-off, in one line (from the provider's
documentation).

ModelSource.description:
Where a generation command's model came from. Iris never chooses a model
itself.

oneOf.description:
The config file: `image.model` for the image operations, `video.model` for
video.

billing.description: Whether the model's requests cost money.

standard_cost.description:
What the standard output of the model's operations costs, so that models
compare on the same output; null when Iris cannot estimate the model's cost
before a call.

summary.description:
What the model is for and its trade-off, in one line (from the provider's
documentation).

OptionValue.description:
A typed, validated option value. Serialized as the JSON string, integer, or
boolean it is.

default.description:
Value in effect when the option is omitted, typed like the option's values
(a string, an integer, or a boolean); null when the provider documents none.

flag.description: Typed CLI flag, or null if only settable with `-O name=value`.

max.description: Largest value of such an `integer`; null for other options.

max_chars.description:
Longest accepted value in characters (Unicode scalar values) of a free-text
option; null for other options.

min.description:
Smallest value of an `integer` that accepts every whole number from `min` to
`max`; null for other options.

syntax.description: Syntax description for pattern-validated and free-text strings.

values.description:
The accepted values, typed like the option's values, when the option accepts
only listed ones: every `enum`, and an `integer` such as a duration of 4, 6,
or 8 seconds. Null otherwise.

OutputPlanView.description: The save target a job recorded when it was submitted.

dir.description:
The absolute output directory resolved at submission (`-d`, `IRIS_OUTPUT_DIR`,
config `output_dir`, or the current directory), where outputs are saved as
`<job_id>.<ext>`; null when `-o` was given. When both are null, the output
directory of the later command applies.

overwrite.description:
Whether `--overwrite` was given at submission: a file already at the target is
replaced.

path.description:
The absolute `-o` path given at submission (with several outputs,
`<stem>-<i>.<ext>`, `i` from 1); null when none was given.

async_job.description: True if the real command would create a provider-native async job.

billing.description: The model's billing: whether the real run costs money.

detach.description:
True if `--detach` was given: the real run would return right after the
submission instead of waiting. Always false for synchronous commands.

label.description:
The label the real run would record the job with (`video generate --label`);
null without one, and for the synchronous commands.

max_cost.description:
The spending cap `--max-cost` applied, in US dollars; null without it. A plan
with a cap exists only when the request's pre-call estimate is at most the cap.

outputs.description:
Absolute output paths. A name the real run generates is shown as its
pattern: `iris-<ulid>.<ext>` for an image, `<job_id>.<ext>` for a video
(`-<i>` before the extension when there are several).

prompt_fingerprint.description:
The fingerprint of the prompt the real run would send, as a video job records
it (`job.prompt_fingerprint`); never the text.

wait.description:
How the real run would wait for its job; null when it does not wait
(`--detach`, and the synchronous commands).

PlanWait.description:
How the real run of `video generate` waits for its job: the caller wait limit
and the time between status checks.

timeout.description:
When it passes, the real run stops waiting and exits 4 (`wait_timeout`); the
job continues remotely.

PromptFingerprint.description:
A prompt's SHA-256 and length: enough to match a job to a prompt one has, not to
recover the prompt.

chars.description: The prompt's length in characters (Unicode scalar values).

sha256.description:
Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the prompt as sent, encoded as UTF-8 (a
`--prompt-file` or `--prompt-stdin` prompt without its trailing whitespace).

ProviderId.description: Provider identifier: one of the listed providers, or a provider a later version of this schema_version adds.

ResultPayload.description:
Every possible `result` payload. Serialized untagged; the envelope's `command`
tells which variant applies (see the `$defs` in the published schema).

StandardCost.description:
The estimated cost of the standard output of a model's operations: the same
output for every model of an operation kind.

estimates.description:
One estimate per request for that output, by the model's own pre-call
estimator: one per quality with an estimate for a model whose quality sets
the price (lowest quality first), else one.

output.description:
The output, in words: `one 1024x1024 image` for the image operations, `one
8-second 720p video` for video.

StandardEstimate.description: One request for the standard output and its estimate.

options.description:
The option values to pass (with their typed flags or `-O name=value`); every
other option keeps its default.

Usage.description: Token/usage information reported by a provider, normalized where possible.

provider_usage.description: Provider usage object as reported (numbers only; unstable shape).

WaitSetting.description:
One wait setting of a plan: its value, where the value came from (as `config
show` reports it), and the ways to set it.

env_var.description: The environment variable that sets it.

flag.description: The command-line flag that sets it.

key.description: The config file key that sets it, as `config show` names the setting.

Warning.description: A non-fatal notice attached to a result.

code.description: Stable warning code (docs/json-contract.md): one of the listed codes, or a code a later version of this schema_version adds. Treat a code you do not know as informational text.

description: The single JSON document printed on stdout in `--json` mode.

schema_version.description: Major version of the JSON output contract; this schema describes version 1.

title: Envelope
